_meta.source: 21st.dev inspired — adapted for Crafter Agency AI client DNA system
_meta.description: Auth forms, dashboards, contact, blog, onboarding, and special effects. All prompts use {{CLIENT_*}} DNA variables.

templates.name: Auth — Split-Screen Login (Form + Visual)
templates.description: Form fields on one side, branded visual panel on the other. Professional login/signup page.
templates.prompt:
Build a split-screen authentication page for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Full-viewport layout: 2 columns (50/50), no scroll.

LEFT panel (form side): background:#08080f, padding:60px, display:flex, align-items:center, justify-content:center.
Form container: max-width:400px, width:100%.
- Logo: '{{CLIENT_NAME}}' + {{CLIENT_LOGO_URL}} if available, mb:32px.
- H1: 'Welcome back' (or 'Create your account'), 28px, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 700.
- Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', 14px muted, mb:32px.
- Email input: label 'Email', input type:email, full-width, height:48px, background:#0e0e1e, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1), border-radius:10px, padding:0 16px, color:white, font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}. Focus: border-color:{{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.15).
- Password input: same style + show/hide toggle eye icon.
- 'Forgot password?' link right-aligned below password.
- Submit: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' full-width, 48px, gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, border-radius:10px, font-weight:700.
- OR divider (thin lines + 'or' text centered).
- Social: Google + GitHub buttons (border style, full-width, 44px, icons left).
- Switch: 'Don't have an account? Sign up →' or vice versa.

RIGHT panel (visual side): background:linear-gradient(135deg, {{CLIENT_COLORS}}), padding:60px. Contains: large quote/benefit text, 3 feature bullets with icons, floating client logos or avatars as social proof.

Mobile: hide right panel, form goes full-width.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Auth — Centered Card on Dark Background
templates.description: Floating card with heading, email, password, CTA, and sign-up link on a full-page dark background.
templates.prompt:
Build a centered card authentication page for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Full-viewport: background:#050510, display:flex, align-items:center, justify-content:center.
Optional background: animated gradient mesh in {{CLIENT_COLORS}} at 8% opacity (same blob technique as tpl_104).

Card: background:#0c0c1a, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), border-radius:20px, padding:48px, width:min(440px,90vw), box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.5).

Inside card:
- Logo centered: '{{CLIENT_NAME}}', font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}, font-weight:700, mb:8px.
- H2: 'Sign in to your account', 22px, centered.
- Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', 13px muted, centered, mb:28px.
- Inputs: Email + Password (same styles as tpl_166).
- 'Remember me' checkbox left + 'Forgot password?' right (flex space-between).
- Submit button: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}', full-width, gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.
- OR divider.
- Google button (single social option or add GitHub).
- Footer: 'No account? {{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' link.

Subtle card glow: box-shadow includes 0 0 60px rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.06).
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Auth — Social-First Login
templates.description: Social login buttons primary at top, email/password secondary below a divider. Optimizes for quick login.
templates.prompt:
Build a social-first auth page for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Full-viewport centered layout. Card: max-width:400px, background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:20px, padding:40px.

Top: logo + 'Sign in to {{CLIENT_NAME}}' heading.

Social buttons FIRST (primary section):
- Google: white background, black text, Google logo SVG left. Full-width, 48px, border-radius:10px. Hover: slight shadow.
- GitHub: dark background #24292e, white text, GitHub Octocat SVG left. Full-width, 48px.
- Optional: Apple ID button (black).
All buttons have border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) on dark backgrounds.

OR divider: mt:24px mb:24px.

Email/password section (secondary, smaller visual weight):
- Inputs more compact (42px height). Same focus styles.
- Submit: filled but slightly smaller, gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, 'Sign in with Email'.
- 'Forgot password?' text link.

Bottom: 'New to {{CLIENT_NAME}}? {{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' (register link in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}).

Privacy note: 'By signing in you agree to our Terms & Privacy' — 11px muted, centered.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Auth — Magic Link (Passwordless)
templates.description: Single email input, one CTA. No password. Magic link flow with confirmation state.
templates.prompt:
Build a magic link passwordless auth page for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Minimal centered card: max-width:380px, centered vertically, background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:20px, padding:48px.

Step 1 (initial state):
- Large magic wand or envelope emoji icon, centered, 48px.
- H2: 'Sign in to {{CLIENT_NAME}}', centered, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 24px.
- Sub: 'We'll email you a secure link — no password needed.', 14px muted, centered, mb:28px.
- Email input: full-width, 50px, bold font-size:16px. Focus border {{CLIENT_COLORS first}}.
- Submit button: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' full-width, 50px, gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.

Step 2 (after submit — show via JS hiding step 1, showing step 2):
- Large ✉️ icon animated (slight bounce @keyframes).
- H2: 'Check your inbox!'
- Sub: 'We sent a sign-in link to [email]. Check spam if you don't see it.'
- Smaller link: '← Use a different email' (resets to step 1).
- '{{CLIENT_USP_1}} · {{CLIENT_USP_2}}' trust line below.

Transition: step 1 fades out (opacity:0, pointer-events:none), step 2 fades in.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Auth — Multi-Step Signup Wizard
templates.description: Progress indicator at top, signup split across 2-3 logical steps with back/next navigation.
templates.prompt:
Build a multi-step signup wizard for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Full-viewport: dark background with subtle gradient blob {{CLIENT_COLORS}} 8% opacity.
Card: max-width:480px, centered, background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:20px, padding:48px.

Progress bar: at top of card. 3 steps. Active step: {{CLIENT_COLORS}} fill. Completed: checkmark. Inactive: muted circle. Label below each: 'Account', 'Profile', 'Setup'.

Step 1 — Account:
- H2: 'Create your account' + sub '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.
- Full name input + Email input + Password input (with strength indicator bar below — 4 segments: weak/fair/good/strong in red/yellow/green/{{CLIENT_COLORS}}).
- 'Next →' button, full-width, {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.
- 'Already have an account? Sign in' link.

Step 2 — Profile:
- H2: 'Tell us about yourself'.
- Dropdown: 'Your role' (Developer, Designer, Marketer, Founder, Other).
- Input: 'Company name' (optional).
- Checkboxes: '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}' — 'I want to...' multi-select.
- Back + Next buttons (flex row).

Step 3 — Done:
- Large ✓ checkmark animation (SVG stroke animation, draws the check).
- H2: 'You're all set!'
- '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' full-width button — takes to app.

Step transitions: current step fades out (opacity:0, x:-20px), next slides in from right (x:20px→0).
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Auth — Minimal Single Column
templates.description: Logo, heading, fields, and CTA stacked cleanly with no card container. Architectural minimalism.
templates.prompt:
Build an ultra-minimal auth page for {{CLIENT_NAME}} (tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}).

Full-viewport: background:#050510 (or pure white if {{CLIENT_TONE}} is light). No card container — form floats directly on background.
Vertical center: padding:60px 24px.

Column: max-width:360px, centered.
- Logo: '{{CLIENT_NAME}}' text only, 24px, font-weight:700, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, mb:48px.
- H1: 'Sign in', 32px, font-weight:300, mb:8px. (Deliberately light weight — contrast with boldness elsewhere.)
- Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', 14px muted, mb:32px.
- Email input: no visible border except bottom border (1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)). Minimal style. On focus: bottom border color:{{CLIENT_COLORS first}}.
- Password input: same style.
- Submit: text-only button or extremely minimal fill — '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}} →', 16px, font-weight:600, color:{{CLIENT_COLORS first}}. No background. Or minimal pill.
- 'Forgot password' link + 'Sign up' link: very small 12px, muted.

No decorative elements. Zero excess. Background can have a single 1px horizontal rule or nothing.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Dashboard — Sidebar + Main Content Layout
templates.description: Full app dashboard layout: sidebar nav + main content area with metric cards and chart area.
templates.prompt:
Build a full dashboard layout for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Outer: height:100vh, display:grid, grid-template-columns:240px 1fr, background:#050510.

Sidebar (tpl_116 pattern): background:#07070f, border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05), overflow-y:auto.
- Logo + version, nav groups, user section bottom.

Main area: overflow-y:auto.

Top header bar: background:#07070f, border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05), padding:14px 28px, display:flex, justify-content:space-between.
- Left: page title + breadcrumb.
- Right: notification bell icon + avatar menu + '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' button.

Content area padding:28px:

1. KPI row: 4 metric cards (same flex/grid). Each: background:#0c0c1a, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05), border-radius:12px, padding:20px. Title (12px muted uppercase), big number (32px, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, white), delta badge (green/red small pill: '+12% vs last month').
Metrics: {{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}}, 'Revenue'.

2. Chart area: large card below KPIs, background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:12px, padding:24px. Title row left + timeframe selector pills right. Chart placeholder: SVG sparkline or canvas drawn as a fake line chart with grid lines (draw using SVG path).

3. Table section: 'Recent Activity' card. Table with columns: Name, Status, Date, Amount. 5 rows of mock data. Status badges (colored pills). Sortable header (arrow icons).

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN. Responsive: sidebar collapses on < 900px.

templates.name: Dashboard — Metric Cards + Line Chart
templates.description: Grid of metric cards at top with a larger interactive chart below. Pure data visualization.
templates.prompt:
Build a metrics dashboard section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Background: #07070f, padding:32px.

4-column KPI grid (2 on mobile):
Each card: background:#0c0c1a, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05), border-radius:14px, padding:22px.
- Metric title: 11px uppercase letter-spacing:0.15em, muted. E.g.: '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}', '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}', 'Total Revenue'.
- Value: 36px, font-weight:300, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, white.
- Delta: pill badge — green (▲ +8.2%) or red (▼ -3.1%). 11px, font-weight:700.
- Sparkline: tiny 60px wide SVG line chart in card bottom-right showing trend.

Main chart card (below KPIs, mt:20px): background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:14px, padding:24px.
- Header: title left, period selector pills right (7d / 30d / 90d / 1y). Active pill: {{CLIENT_COLORS}} bg.
- Chart area: min-height:300px. Draw a smooth SVG line chart:
  * X axis: 12 date labels.
  * Y axis: 5 value labels.
  * Grid lines: horizontal dashes rgba(255,255,255,0.04).
  * Line path: smooth cubic bezier in {{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, stroke-width:2.5.
  * Area fill: same color at 10% opacity.
  * Hover tooltip: vertical line + dot + value popup.
- Period selector JS: updates chart data arrays and redraws.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Dashboard — Kanban Board
templates.description: Columns representing stages with draggable cards within each. Full Kanban with drag-drop.
templates.prompt:
Build a Kanban board for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Full page layout: background:#050510, overflow-x:auto.
Topbar: '{{CLIENT_NAME}} Board' title, '+ Add Task' button ({{CLIENT_COLORS}}), filter pills (All / Mine / Due Today).

Kanban columns: flex row, gap:16px, padding:24px, min-width:max-content.
4 columns: 'Backlog' | 'In Progress' | 'Review' | 'Done'.

Each column: min-width:280px, background:#07070a, border-radius:14px, padding:16px, flex:0 0 280px.
- Column header: flex space-between — label (13px, 600, {{CLIENT_FONT}}) + count badge ({{CLIENT_COLORS}} pill) + '+' add button.
- Cards container: flex column, gap:10px.

Each card: background:#0d0d1a, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06), border-radius:10px, padding:14px, cursor:grab.
- Priority dot (top-right): red/yellow/green.
- Title: 14px, white, 600.
- Description: 12px, muted, 2 lines max.
- Bottom row: avatar circle + due date (12px muted) + label pill (category: e.g. '{{CLIENT_SECTOR}}' or feature name).

Drag: HTML5 draggable=true + dragstart/dragover/drop events. On drop: move card to new column. Visual feedback: dragging card opacity:0.5, target column highlights.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Dashboard — Three-Pane Layout
templates.description: Sidebar, middle list/feed pane, and detail panel on the right. Email/Slack-style app layout.
templates.prompt:
Build a three-pane dashboard layout for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Full viewport: display:grid, grid-template-columns:220px 320px 1fr, background:#040409.

Pane 1 (leftmost sidebar): background:#07070d, border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04), overflow-y:auto. Logo at top + vertical nav (same as tpl_116 compact). Icons + labels.

Pane 2 (middle list): background:#09090f, border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04), overflow-y:auto.
- Top: search input (full-width, 36px, #0e0e1e bg, {{CLIENT_FONT}}) + filter icons row.
- Pane title: '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}' (14px bold, padding:16px).
- List of items (8-12): each item = clickable row, padding:12px 16px, border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03).
  Row: avatar (32px) + right content: title (13px bold white) + preview (12px muted, truncated) + time (11px muted, right).
  Active item: background:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.08), border-left:2px solid {{CLIENT_COLORS first}}.
  Hover: background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02).

Pane 3 (detail view): background:#07070d, padding:28px, overflow-y:auto.
- Header: title (20px bold), subtitle (13px muted), action buttons row (Reply, Archive, etc.).
- Content area: full detail view with metadata + body text.
- Bottom: action bar with input + send button.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN. Responsive: panes collapse on mobile (show one at a time with back button).

templates.name: Dashboard — Empty State
templates.description: Centered illustration or icon, heading, supporting sentence, and CTA to get started. For first-time users.
templates.prompt:
Build an empty state screen for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Full content area: display:flex, align-items:center, justify-content:center, min-height:60vh, background:#07070f.

Centered column: text-align:center, max-width:400px.

Illustration: large SVG illustration or emoji/icon composition (80px). Possible: a rounded rectangle card with dotted border + '+' icon in center (100px × 80px, border:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.15), border-radius:16px, background:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.04)). Or use a CSS-only abstract shape.

H2: 'No {{CLIENT_PRODUCT}} yet' or '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', 22px, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, 600, mt:24px.
Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', 14px, muted, line-height:1.6, mb:28px.

CTA: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' button, filled {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, pill shape, 48px.
Secondary: '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' text link below button.

Optional: 3-step mini guide below CTA ('1 → Upload · 2 → Configure · 3 → Launch') in pill steps, 12px muted.

Animation: SVG illustration has subtle CSS float animation (translateY 0→-8px, 3s ease-in-out infinite).

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Contact — Split Form + Contact Details
templates.description: Contact form on one side, contact details (email, phone, address, hours) on the other.
templates.prompt:
Build a contact section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}, {{CLIENT_LOCATION}}).

Section: padding:100px 0, background:#07070f.
Header: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}', centered, mb:64px.

2-column grid (1 on mobile), gap:64px, max-width:1100px:

LEFT — Form:
H3: 'Send us a message', mb:24px.
- Name input (full-width).
- Email input.
- Select: 'I'm interested in...' dropdown with options: {{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}}, 'Other'.
- Textarea: 'Message' — min-height:120px.
- Submit: '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' full-width gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.
- All inputs: background:#0c0c1a, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), border-radius:10px, padding:12px 16px, color:white, font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}. Focus: border-color:{{CLIENT_COLORS first}}.

RIGHT — Details: background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:16px, padding:36px, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06).
- Section heading '{{CLIENT_NAME}}'.
- Contact items (icon + text, 3 rows):
  📧 Email address placeholder.
  📍 {{CLIENT_LOCATION}}.
  📸 Instagram: {{CLIENT_INSTAGRAM}}.
- Business hours block.
- Map placeholder: div with border-radius:12px, background:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.06), height:160px, centered 'Open in Maps →' link.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Contact — Support Channel Cards
templates.description: Grid of cards for different support channels with icon, title, description, and CTA link.
templates.prompt:
Build a support channels section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Section: background:#07070f, padding:100px 0.
Header: 'How Can We Help?' centered. Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'.

Grid: 3 cols (1 on mobile), gap:20px, max-width:960px, mt:48px.

6 channel cards:
1. 💬 Live Chat — 'Talk to a real human' — 'Open Chat →' link. Status badge: '● Online' (green).
2. 📧 Email Support — '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}' — 'Send Email →' mailto link.
3. 📚 Documentation — '{{CLIENT_USP_2}}' — 'Browse Docs →'.
4. 🐛 Bug Report — 'Found an issue?' — 'Submit Report →'.
5. 🤝 Enterprise Support — '{{CLIENT_USP_3}}' — 'Contact Sales →' (primary CTA style).
6. 💡 Community — 'Join the {{CLIENT_NAME}} community' — 'Join Forum →'.

Each card: background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:16px, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06), padding:28px.
- Icon: 44px, background:rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.1), border-radius:12px, mb:16px.
- Title: 16px, 700, white, {{CLIENT_FONT}}.
- Description: 13px, muted, line-height:1.5, mb:16px.
- CTA link: 13px, {{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, '→' arrow.

Hover: border-color rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.3), translateY(-4px).
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. GSAP stagger. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Contact — Full-Page Minimal Form
templates.description: Full-page centered form with large heading, minimal fields, and a prominent submit button.
templates.prompt:
Build a full-page minimal contact form for {{CLIENT_NAME}} (tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}).

Full-viewport: background:#050510, display:flex, align-items:center, justify-content:center.

Form: max-width:560px, width:100%, padding:60px 0.

Top: eyebrow '{{CLIENT_SECTOR}} · {{CLIENT_LOCATION}}', small uppercase 11px.
H1: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' — 48px, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, font-weight:700, mb:8px.
Sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' — 16px muted, mb:48px.

Fields (underline-only style — minimal):
- Each field: full-width, border:none, border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15), background:transparent, padding:12px 0, font-size:16px, color:white, font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}, outline:none.
- Focus: border-bottom-color:{{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, transition:0.3s.
- Floating label: label starts inside field, on focus/fill floats above (translateY(-24px), font-size:11px, color:{{CLIENT_COLORS first)}}.
- Fields: Name, Company (optional), Email, Message (textarea 4 rows, resize:none).

Submit: mt:40px, display:flex, align-items:center, gap:12px.
- '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' styled as text + large arrow → that slides right on hover (transform:translateX(6px), transition:0.3s).
OR as standard pill button in {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.

Background decoration: one color blob {{CLIENT_COLORS}} far right, blur:140px, 10% opacity.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Blog — Magazine Grid Layout
templates.description: Large featured post at top with smaller cards in a grid beneath. Editorial magazine style.
templates.prompt:
Build a blog/magazine grid for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}).

Section: background:#07070f, padding:80px 0.
Header: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', sub: '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}'. Category filter pills: All, {{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}}.

Featured post (top row, full width): horizontal card, 2 cols (visual 55% + content 45%), background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:16px, overflow:hidden, min-height:360px.
- Left: image placeholder (gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, aspect fill).
- Right: padding:40px. Category pill ({{CLIENT_COLORS}}). H2 (28px, 700). Excerpt (14px muted, 3 lines). Read time + date metadata. Author row: avatar + name + '5 min read'.

Smaller cards grid (below featured): 3-col (2 on tablet, 1 on mobile), gap:20px, mt:20px.
Each card: background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:12px, overflow:hidden.
- Image top: 200px, gradient placeholder.
- Content: padding:20px. Category pill small. Title (16px bold). Excerpt (13px muted, 2 lines). Bottom: date + read time.

Hover: scale:1.02, box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), transition:0.3s.
'Load more' button below grid.

GSAP stagger reveal. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Blog — Single Article Reading View
templates.description: Clean single-column article with generous line spacing, readable width, and sticky TOC.
templates.prompt:
Build a blog article reading page for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Layout: 2-col — article body left (650px) + sticky TOC sidebar right (220px), max-width:1000px, centered, padding:60px 24px.

Article:
- Eyebrow: category pill + read time + date.
- H1: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' — 40px, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, font-weight:700, line-height:1.2.
- Author row: avatar + '{{CLIENT_NAME}} Team' + date.
- Hero image placeholder: full-width, aspect-ratio:16/9, border-radius:12px, background:gradient {{CLIENT_COLORS}}.
- Article body: font-size:17px, line-height:1.8, color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8), font-family:{{CLIENT_FONT}}.
  * H2 headings: 22px, border-left:3px solid {{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, pl:16px.
  * Blockquote: italic, border-left:4px solid {{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, pl:20px, my:32px.
  * Code blocks: background:#0d0d1e, font-family:monospace, border-radius:8px, padding:16px.
  * 4 paragraphs of placeholder content referencing {{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}}.

Sticky TOC (desktop only): position:sticky, top:80px. Heading 'Table of Contents' 12px uppercase. Links scroll smoothly to H2 sections. Active link: {{CLIENT_COLORS first}}.

Progress bar: thin line at very top of viewport, width fills as user reads.
Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Blog — Card Grid with Category Filters
templates.description: Post card grid with category filter tags above. Instant filter with JS. Clean modern layout.
templates.prompt:
Build a filterable blog card grid for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Section: padding:80px 0, background:#07070f.
Header: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}', centered.

Filter bar: flex, centered, gap:10px, mb:40px.
Filter pills: All | {{CLIENT_USP_1}} | {{CLIENT_USP_2}} | {{CLIENT_USP_3}} | {{CLIENT_SECTOR}}.
Each pill: border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1), border-radius:100px, padding:6px 16px, 13px. Active: background:{{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, border:transparent, white. Hover: border-color:{{CLIENT_COLORS first}}.

Cards grid: auto-fill minmax(300px,1fr), gap:20px.
9 cards, each with data-category attribute matching filter pills.

Each card: background:#0c0c1a, border-radius:14px, overflow:hidden, border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05).
- Image top: 200px gradient placeholder.
- Tags row: category pill (11px, colored by category).
- Title: 16px bold, 2 lines max, {{CLIENT_FONT}}.
- Excerpt: 13px muted.
- Bottom: date + reading time + author avatar (28px).

Filter JS: click pill → filter cards (cards with non-matching category get opacity:0 + scale:0.96, matching ones animate in). Smooth CSS transitions.

GSAP scroll reveal. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Blog — Sidebar Table of Contents
templates.description: Article with sticky sidebar TOC that highlights the current section as user scrolls.
templates.prompt:
Build a long-form article with sticky sidebar TOC for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Same layout as tpl_181 but TOC is the star feature:

TOC sidebar: position:sticky, top:80px, max-height:calc(100vh - 100px), overflow-y:auto, padding-right:12px.
- Heading: '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' 11px uppercase letter-spacing:0.2em, muted, mb:16px.
- 7 TOC links corresponding to H2 sections. Each: display:block, padding:6px 0 6px 12px, font-size:13px, border-left:2px solid transparent, transition:all 0.25s, text-decoration:none.

Progress indicator: thin vertical line between TOC and article, fills with {{CLIENT_COLORS}} as reading progress advances.

templates.name: Special — Magnetic Cursor Effect
templates.description: Custom cursor with magnetic attraction to buttons and links. Premium interactive experience.
templates.prompt:
Build a magnetic cursor system for {{CLIENT_NAME}} (tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}).

Custom cursor: on desktop only (pointer device), hide default cursor (body{cursor:none}), create 2 cursor elements:
1. Dot: 10px, border-radius:50%, background:{{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, position:fixed, z-index:99999, pointer-events:none, transition: none (raw position).
2. Follower ring: 36px, border:2px solid rgba({{CLIENT_COLORS first}},0.5), border-radius:50%, position:fixed, z-index:99998, pointer-events:none, transition:transform 0.15s ease, width/height 0.2s, opacity 0.2s.

JS: document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { dot.style.left/top = e.clientX/Y + 'px'; follower uses lerp to smoothly follow }).

Magnetic buttons: all .btn, a, button elements — on mouseenter, compute element center, on mousemove within 60px of element: element translates toward cursor (offset × 0.3), cursor ring scales:1.6 + opacity:0.3 (absorbed look).
On mouseleave: element springs back to origin (transition 0.4s elastic).

State changes:
- Hover text: follower ring scales:2.0, dot disappears, 'Read' text inside ring (font:11px {{CLIENT_FONT}}).
- Hover button: ring fills with {{CLIENT_COLORS first}} 30% opacity.
- Hover image: ring scale:3, mix-blend-mode:difference if on light.

Works alongside existing page content. Disable on touch devices (matchMedia hover:none).
Vanilla HTML + Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Special — Page Transitions (Curtain/Fade)
templates.description: Animated page transitions with curtain slide or fade effect between internal page loads.
templates.prompt:
Build a page transition system for {{CLIENT_NAME}} multi-page site.

Transition overlay: position:fixed, inset:0, z-index:9999, pointer-events:none.

Style: curtain wipe using {{CLIENT_COLORS}} gradient. A div that slides from bottom (translateY:100%) to cover screen (translateY:0%) over 0.4s, then new page loads, then curtain retreats upward (translateY:-100%) over 0.4s.

JS:
1. document.querySelectorAll('a[href]') — intercept internal link clicks.
2. On click: prevent default. Add .is-exiting class to body. Overlay animates in.
3. After 0.4s (transition in): window.location.href = link.href.
4. On DOMContentLoaded: overlay is visible (translateY:0). Add class to animate OUT (translateY:-100%, 0.4s).
5. After out animation: remove overlay or hide.

Alternative GSAP version: timeline — tl.to(overlay, {yPercent:0, duration:0.4, ease:'power2.in'}) → navigate → tl.to(overlay, {yPercent:-100, duration:0.4, ease:'power2.out'}).

Curtain color: {{CLIENT_COLORS first}} or solid dark (#050510). Optional: {{CLIENT_NAME}} logo appears centered while curtain is closed (logo fades in during in-animation, fades out during out-animation).

Backup: simple fade (body opacity:0→1 on load, 0.3s) as fallback.

Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}. Vanilla JS. Tailwind CDN.

templates.name: Special — Confetti / Success Celebration
templates.description: Canvas-based confetti burst for celebrating user milestones, form submissions, or achievements.
templates.prompt:
Build a confetti celebration system for {{CLIENT_NAME}}.

Create a reusable confettiBlast() function triggered on milestone events (form submit, plan upgrade, etc.).

<canvas id='confetti-canvas'> positioned:fixed, inset:0, z-index:99998, pointer-events:none, width:100vw, height:100vh.

JS confetti particles:
- 120 particles created at blast() call.
- Each particle: x:random(0,canvas.width), y:canvas.height×0.6 (emit from center), vx:random(-8,8), vy:random(-18,-6), gravity:0.4, rotation:random(0,360), rotationSpeed:random(-8,8), size:random(6,14), shape: random from ['rect','circle','triangle'], color: random from [{{CLIENT_COLORS first}}, {{CLIENT_COLORS second}}, '#ffffff', '#ffd700', '#ff69b4', '#00ff88'].

Animation loop: requestAnimationFrame. Each frame: update particle positions + rotation + apply gravity. Draw each particle at new position. Fade opacity after 1.5s (lifetime). Stop animation when all particles off-screen.

Success overlay (optional): before confetti, briefly show centered message:
- ✓ checkmark SVG animates (stroke-dashoffset draw animation).
- H2: '{{CLIENT_USP_1}}!' or 'You did it!'.
- Fades out after 2s.

Expose: window.{{CLIENT_NAME}}Confetti = { blast: confettiBlast }. Call with window.CrafterConfetti.blast().

Tone: {{CLIENT_TONE}}. Vanilla JS only. No dependencies.
